design.name: 寒甲都护
design.brief: Chapter boss, the Frozen Protector-General (寒甲都护) of Beiting riding his war yak: a gigantic Tang general in ornate gold-trimmed lacquer-red and dark-iron armour with a tall winged helmet, a grim bearded iron mask and a long red cape torn and frozen stiff, riding a colossal armoured war yak with huge curved horns, a shaggy white fur skirt and iron barding; ice crystals grow from both of them and a glowing cyan heart-core shines in the general's chest (weak spot). Two phases: mounted, then he leaps down. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers.
design.weapon: a giant guandao (偃月刀) raised high from the saddle as the yak rears
design.style_note: Style target: the enemies of Gunfire Reborn — a readable military unit roster where every troop type is told apart at 30 m by silhouette and weapon. Strongly stylized, chunky and exaggerated: big helmets and pauldrons, oversized hands and weapons, compact sturdy bodies, faces hidden behind iron masks with two glowing cyan eye slits, bold saturated colour blocks (lacquer red, dark iron, bronze, white fur, cyan glow), clean bevelled forms, armour plates as a few big shapes, no tiny detail noise. Menacing and cool, not cute.
